ops.body: Half landed: fusekit v1.2.0 (main d101757) exports proc.Flock / proc.FlockHandle.Release — cp-then-edit from cc-pool's byte-identical copies, semantics unchanged (25ms LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB poll, ctx cancel, lock file left on disk), refuter-verified zero behavioral drift; tests strengthened (DeadlineExceeded identity, child exit status). Remaining half (delete internal/pool/flock.go + internal/hostsync/flock.go in favor of it) rides cc-pool v0.56.0 unit 2r — close on that landing.
